title: List of Turkish Air Force aircraft

rows: Nearly all active aircraft were built under license by TAI. Block 30s are being upgraded to 'TM' standard. Block 40s and 50s have been upgraded under the PO-III and F-16 MSM/CCIP to Block 50+ standard. They will further be upgraded under F-16 Özgür program which is already being applied to Block 30s. 60 F-16Ds are used for conversion training. 1 used by SoloTürk demonstration team.
